notes.title: Update 2.2.5
notes.content:
Ahoy Seaorama Captains! ⚓️

We’re excited to announce that Update 2.2.5 for Seaorama: World of Shipping is now live! This update includes essential fixes and enhancements to improve your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

🆕 New Features


 New log entry when a ship travels to a port for repairs.
 New Security insurance calculations. Now the cost is only for the trip leading to the port affected by piracy.
 New R&D window. Unlock upgrades through research to install on your ships and meet the requirements of the crew members. (R&D is available only when you start a new game session. Older saves will use the old format.)
 A new way of calculating the value of a share of a port, making it more affordable to invest.
 Added new column with Net Profit visible at Finance & Accounts.


🔧 Fixes and Improvements


 Improved Details at the Crew Members profile window. Know from before what upgrades to the ship each member will demand at each level and plan ahead with the new R&D department.
 Improved Details considering the percentage of event avoidance a crew member offers at the Crew Members profile window.
 Improved Port Investments window. See which ports sell shares, and know their ranking before investing. You can now also sell your shares from one port if you need money to invest elsewhere. AI companies can also buy shares, so be vigilant when new shares become available.
 Fix incomes/outcomes bugs.
 Fix Charter contract bug.
 Workshop packages hotfixes.
 Better breakdown for percentage and full amount of fuel at the Fuel window in Operations.
 Changes to Contract bonuses for the Game modes. Easy Mode now gets +60%, Medium Mode gets +30%, and Hard Mode (plus Ranked Mode) gets no bonuses from the contracts.


We’re committed to continually improving Seaorama: World of Shipping and appreciate your feedback. Enjoy the new features and fixes in this latest update!

The Seaorama Team 🚢💙

notes.title: 2.2 VERSION IS OUT!
notes.content:
Hey Captains, 

After months of development, we’re excited to roll out the biggest update yet — Version 2.2.1 is now live on Steam. This release brings a major expansion to how you play, including a full custom content system, gameplay improvements, and quality of life upgrades. Let’s take a look. 🚀

🛠️ Custom Content System: Your World, Your Rules

One of the most requested features has been the ability to customize the game world, and we’ve delivered a system built entirely around flexibility and creativity.


 Add or remove ports at will,

 Customize ports with a name, description, and specific port type,

 Define the available products in every port,

 Create custom in-game events and set when and how they appear,

 Change the map’s visual style using selectable themes,


This system is modular. You can mix and match content from different creators, combine your own designs with others’, and build entirely new gameplay experiences tailored to your vision.


🌐 Community Sharing and Syncing

You can now easily share and explore custom content across the community:


 Upload and share ports, events, and map themes,

 Browse and download community creations directly in-game,




⚙️ Gameplay and Quality of Life Updates 

Version 2.2.1 brings dozens of improvements to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable:


 Game speed increased by 25% for faster progression

 Quick sell and scrap options in the ship operations screen

 Smoother zooming and bug fixes for map navigation

 New crew morale filter: Red → Yellow → Green,

 Double-click a ship to open its operations view,

 Upgrade indicators for eligible crew members,

 Indicator for new managers CV's,

 One-click refill and repair to maximum,

 Toggle ship names on or off in the map view,

 Automatic scrapping of retired ships,

 Brighter hover highlights in ship list,

 Search bar added to ship operations,

 Use arrow keys to navigate the map,




Dive in, explore the tools, create your world, and share it with others.
Post here your custom package ⁠workshop-packages 

Thank you for being part of this amazing community. We can’t wait to see what you build!

notes.title: Big Expansion Preview — Build Your World, Your Way!
notes.content:
🌟 Big Expansion Preview — Build Your World, Your Way!

Hey Captains! 👋
We’ve been cooking up something huge behind the scenes for the past few months, and it’s finally time to start sharing what’s coming. This is more than just an update — it’s a whole new way to play the game. Let’s jump in! 🚀

🛠️ Build, Customize — Your World, Your Rules
One of the biggest requests we’ve gotten from you all has been more ports, more events, more control. We hear you — and we’re taking it to the next level!

We’re introducing a brand-new content system that lets you, the player, create and customize game elements:

✨ Add or remove ports whenever you want
🏗️ Give ports custom names, descriptions, and define what type of port they are
🚢 Choose which products are available in each port
🎉 Create your own in-game events to shake things up
🗺️ Even change the look and feel of the map with different styles and themes

Everything is modular — so you can keep things simple or go wild with hundreds of ports and events. There’s no limit to what you can add!

Ports, events and map customs can be mixed from different creators each one of them.

🌐 Share Your Creations With the Community
Want to show off your custom world? Or maybe you just want to explore what others have made?
We’re adding support for syncing and sharing custom content online! That means:

🌍 Download community-created ports, events, and maps
👍 Rate and discover the best content made by other players
🔁 Easily switch between different setups to try out fresh gameplay experiences


🧪 Beta Testing Coming Soon!
We’re getting super close to release, and we want your feedback to make this expansion the best it can be! 🛠️

We’ll be running a public beta for one week in our beta channel so you can try all these features early and help us test things out.
Stay tuned for the exact date—we’ll announce it very soon!

📸 P.S. The screenshots we’re sharing are still work in progress, but we wanted to give you a glimpse at what’s coming.

Thanks again for being part of this amazing community — we can’t wait to see what you’ll create! 💙

notes.title: Ver. 2.1.7 - Ranked and Gameplay Enhancements!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

We’re thrilled to announce the arrival of Version 2.1.7 for Seaorama: World of Shipping. This update introduces new features, gameplay improvements, and essential bug fixes. Read on for all the details!

🏆 Ranked Mode Enhancements

Season History: A new tab in the Leaderboard window displays your season history and past placements.
Ranked Achievements: We’ve added 8 new achievements exclusive to Ranked mode.
DISCLAIMER: The Ranked leaderboard is monitored for cheaters. Any cheating detected will result in a permanent ban from Ranked gameplay. You will still be able to play non-Ranked sessions.


⚙️ Gameplay Improvements

Available Contracts Window: Hover over the Duration number to see a breakdown of trip time and loading/unloading time. Added reminders in the Ship Information section to show the total loading/unloading time for all acquired contracts. Duration recalculations ensure updated trip times.
Readjusted Interest Rates: Country economy now affects interest rates. Loan interest rates will vary based on the loan amount, installments, and the country’s economy.
Ship Events: When a ship event requires player action, you will now see details of the current contract next to the available choices for informed decision-making.
Request CVs: Added a new option to request CVs every 15 days (requires the appropriate advisor).


🔧 Quality of Life (QoL) Updates

Country of Base: The selected base country now displays above the Menu bar.
Mass Dismiss Crew Members: A button allows you to dismiss all crew members at once when selling or scrapping a ship.
New Icons: Fresh icons added for ships on the map for easier identification.
Ship ECO Reminder: ECO calculation reminder text added in the Speed section of the Operations Overview.
AI Tweak: Opponent AI has been made slightly more aggressive when purchasing ships.


🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed ships losing contracts after loading a save file.
Resolved issues with the crew member experience bar.
Fixed crew member filters not functioning correctly.
Addressed ships moving over land after loading a save file.


[hr][/hr]
We hope you enjoy these new updates! Thank you for your continued support, and happy sailing!

— The Seaorama Team 🌊🚢

notes.title: Patch 2.1.3 - QoL Updates!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Seaorama: World of Shipping Version 2.1.3 is live! This update brings several fixes, features, and quality of life improvements, many of which were suggested by you! Here's what's new:
    🔧 Fixes & Optimizations            Managers: Managers will now ensure ships are maintained at an overall condition of 90% or higher, up from the previous 50%, ensuring that your fleet remains in top shape.        Ship Events: Adjustments have been made to balance the occurrence of ship events (looking at you, Windlasses!) even on fully upgraded ships with experienced crews.        Crew Resigning: The resignation countdown will now only start when a ship is idle and will reset with every trip. Ships with low-morale crew members will be unable to take new contracts, but they can still use the "Add to Queue" option to move to a nearby shipyard for repairs or upgrades.        🌟 General Improvements            Sell / Bid UI: We've added the ability to add/subtract 10M in the UI for faster input when adjusting amounts.        Filters: A new "Hide Filtered Ships" option has been added to the main screen, allowing you to hide selected ships (such as Managed ships) from the map.        Facilities: Just like the Ship Upgrades tab, there is now a single button to enable all facilities at once, streamlining the upgrade process.        Contracts Flat Fee: By popular demand, we’ve added a filtering option for the Flat Fee. You can now view the Flat Fee of a contract as Total Fee, Per Day, or Per Mile, depending on your preference.        New Ship Notification: When a new ship is ready to sail, a notification will now appear at the center of your screen, replacing the smaller notification that previously appeared on the right side for a more prominent alert.        
We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. As always, thank you for your feedback and support! Keep sailing and optimizing your fleets in Seaorama: World of Shipping.
    
Fair winds and following seas,
    The Seaorama Team 🚢💙

notes.title: 1.09.4: Stability and Enhancements
notes.content:
Hello, Seaorama Players! 

We are rolling out version 1.09.4 with a sense of commitment to our dedicated players. We apologize for the recent challenges and appreciate your patience. After thorough investigation, we discovered a bug in our game engine that was affecting stability. This update is our response to that, where we've not only fixed the bug but also converted key elements to enhance overall performance and stability. 

Here's what you can expect in this revised update:

[hr][/hr]
Stability and Performance
    
        Crash Fixes: Implemented solutions to address stability issues and reduce game crashing.
        UI Performance Boost: Enhanced performance of the UI for a smoother experience.
        [hr][/hr]
    Improvements
    
        Charterers and Contracts Fixes: Adjustments and fixes to charterers and charter contracts for better management.
        Trip Report and Contract History: Trip Report History and Contract Completed per ship are now limited to the last 20 entries for clarity.
        Save System Adjustment: Improvements made to the save system for reliability and efficiency.
        AI Ships Transparency: AI ships now have added transparency to draw less attention, enhancing focus on player-controlled ships.
        Ship Selection Memory: When switching windows, the same ship will remain selected for consistency.
        5-Star CV Generation Adjustments: Fine-tuned the generation of 5-Star CVs for balance.
        Decimal Formatting: Decimals will not appear on large numbers, commonly seen in payments, for better readability.
        Rank Position in UI: Added a feature to show rank position in the bottom bar of the UI.
      [hr][/hr]
    Bug Fixes
    
        Event Auto-Close: Fixed an issue where auto-close events were not functioning as expected.
        Scroll List Behavior: Corrected the scroll list behavior for smoother navigation.
        Translation Fixes: Addressed various translation inaccuracies across the game.
        NaN Reputation Issue: Resolved the 'NaN' problem in the reputation system for accuracy and clarity.
    
        [hr][/hr]
This update is part of our ongoing commitment to providing a stable, enjoyable, and continuously improving Seaorama experience. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please let us know your thoughts on these latest changes.

Thank you for your continued support and happy sailing!

    
The Seaorama Team

Hello, Seaorama Players!😊

We're excited to announce our latest game updates, which includes several optimizations, game changes, and bug fixes. Our team has worked hard to enhance your gaming experience, and we're thrilled to share the details with you.

   Red: Indicates something bad has happened.

notes.title: 7 DAYS TO GO!
notes.content:
Hello crewmates,

We've compiled a dozen fascinating facts – whether you're already familiar with them or not, these tidbits are sure to captivate your interest in sea–related things!

Historical Maritime Trivia:

Golden Age of Piracy (17th-18th centuries):The Golden Age of Piracy, spanning the late 17th to early 18th centuries, saw notorious pirates like Blackbeard, Captain Kidd, and Anne Bonny roaming the seas, capturing imaginations with their daring exploits.

Age of Exploration (15th-17th centuries):During the Age of Exploration, intrepid sailors like Christopher Columbus, Ferdinand Magellan, and Vasco da Gama embarked on groundbreaking voyages, expanding maritime knowledge and connecting distant corners of the globe.

The First Recorded Naval Battle:The battle of Salamis was a naval battle fought in 480 BC, between an alliance of Greek city-states under Themistocles, and the Persian empire under king Xerxes. It resulted in a decisive victory for the outnumbered Greeks. The battle of salamis was the first great naval battle recorded in history.

Battle of Trafalgar (1805):The Battle of Trafalgar, a pivotal naval engagement during the Napoleonic Wars, marked Admiral Nelson's heroic last stand against the combined fleets of France and Spain, solidifying British naval supremacy.

Titanic Tragedy (1912):The sinking of the RMS Titanic in 1912, considered one of the deadliest maritime disasters, became a symbol of human hubris and led to significant improvements in maritime safety regulations.

Transatlantic Cable (19th century):The laying of the transatlantic telegraph cable in the 19th century revolutionized global communication, enabling near-instantaneous transmission of messages between Europe and North America.


Only 7 days away from launch!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843914/cb506c9915387bc22d58deb7ad586036934045e5.jpg
Maritime Legends, Traditions & Myths:

Davy Jones's Locker:"Davy Jones's Locker" refers to the bottom of the sea, often used to describe a sailor's grave. The mythical Davy Jones is believed to be the spirit of the sea, claiming the souls of deceased sailors.

Flying Dutchman:The legend of the Flying Dutchman tells of a ghost ship doomed to sail the seas forever. It's said to be a harbinger of doom to those who encounter it, appearing as a phantom vessel on stormy nights.

Mermaids and Sirens:Throughout history, sailors have shared tales of enchanting mermaids and sirens luring seafarers with their mesmerizing voices. These mythical creatures embody the allure and danger of the sea.

Neptune and Crossing the Equator Rituals:Sailors often engaged in rituals when crossing the Equator to appease Neptune, the mythical god of the sea. These ceremonies, known as "Crossing the Line" rituals, involved playful initiations for sailors who had not crossed the equator before.

Kraken:The Kraken, a legendary sea monster, is often depicted as a giant cephalopod capable of dragging entire ships and sailors beneath the waves. Stories of the Kraken have permeated maritime folklore for centuries.

Bermuda Triangle Enigma:The Bermuda Triangle, a region in the western part of the North Atlantic Ocean, has been shrouded in mystery due to reported incidents of missing ships and aircraft, contributing to its reputation as a maritime enigma.

notes.title: SeaOrama: World of Shipping is Charting a Course to PC Release
notes.content:
PID Games publishing label is partnering up with Hidden Tower, an indie game development studio, to bring back the entrepreneurial spirit through management and simulation game SeaOrama: World of Shipping. 
 
So, we are delighted to announce that SeaOrama will be releasing this year on PC. Meanwhile to make it worth your wait, we will be releasing a Steam Demo for SeaOrama during our participation in the Steam Next Fest from 9th- 16th October 2023.

DEMO SETS SAIL: October 9th 2023!

Experience the challenges of running a successful shipping company with Seaorama: World of Shipping. In Seaorama, you'll have access to a fleet of over 17 types of ships and 90 port locations. But getting goods from one port to another is just the beginning…

Start Your Own Shipping Company 

Embark on a thrilling entrepreneurial journey as you establish and nurture your very own shipping company in Seaorama: World of Shipping. Begin with a single vessel and transform it into a maritime empire. Strategize, invest wisely, and watch your company grow from humble beginnings to a dominant force in the global trade arena. 

Plan Trade Routes Between 90 Port Locations 

Create your own trade routes across an expansive world map featuring 90 port locations. Each destination offers unique challenges and opportunities. Analyze market trends, factor in geopolitical events, and master the art of logistics to optimize your routes for maximum profitability and efficiency. 

Manage Your Ships & Contracts 

Take control of a versatile fleet comprising 17 types of vessels. From cargo vessels to container ships, ensure that your fleet is well-maintained and equipped. Strike lucrative contracts with clients and meticulously oversee every aspect of your shipping operations. Adapt to unforeseen challenges and keep your cargo moving, no matter what obstacles arise.

And Rise as the Shipping Industry's Next Kingpin

Dive into the deep end of maritime adventure and navigate your way to success in this oceanic venture. SeaOrama invites players to chart their course, master the tides, and ride the currents of commerce in a captivating world where every decision holds the key to maritime magnificence.

Play the Demo and Wishlist Now:
